LESSON: HEALING THE PARALYSED MAN

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus
Topic 3.5: Healing the Paralysed Man

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Healing the Paralysed Man
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is the healing of the paralysed man significant to Christians today?

1. describe the healing of the paralysed man

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “describe the healing of the paralysed man” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the healing of the paralysed man" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the healing of the paralysed man

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the healing of the paralysed man

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Healing the Paralysed Man.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the healing of the paralysed man significant to Christians today?
